narrative:
The FY2026/27 Partnership plan targets GBP 13.2B net sales, up 3.4% on FY2025/26. For the first time the baseline is not a consolidated Excel PMIS pack: it is an AI forecast built on Oracle Finance CDC actuals and Waitrose Financial Foundations sales, stock and margin data already landed in Snowflake.

Waitrose carries the growth at GBP 8.07B (+4.0%), helped by 28 refurbished shops trading 6% ahead of control and three new convenience openings. John Lewis plans GBP 4.94B (+2.2%), but the AI forecast flags big-ticket Home and Electricals tracking closer to +0.9%.

Key risk: the John Lewis target rests on an Excel budget assumption the actuals no longer support. The PMIS Forecast Agent proposes trimming it 1.5% and lifting Waitrose 1.8%.

signals.title: PMIS still mastered in Excel
signals.excerpt: Management income statement, budget, forecast and cash flow live in spreadsheets. Reporting-line definitions exist only in workbooks, so every cycle re-reconciles the same numbers.

signals.title: Waitrose Financial Foundations gold data
signals.excerpt: Daily sales, stock and margin modelled to gold standard and already used by the Waitrose Daily Sales CoWork agent. John Lewis equivalent requires foundational work.

signals.title: UK consumer confidence softening on big-ticket
signals.excerpt: Major-purchase intentions down for the third month; grocery volumes resilient while discretionary home and electricals soften.
